purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove Villaeffekten eligibility, amount, deadline safety, budget availability or payment.

mappings.product_miss: v34 made Villaeffekten current and review-gated in the common truth layer, but the public situation shell still could not turn ordinary homeowner language into that verified-source path. A user could therefore encounter generic economy/housing routes even though the product already knew the critical owner/residence, value-year, district-heating, measure, timing, document and material-cost boundaries. Self-critique also found two truth-to-runtime drift risks: treating permanent residence as an application-day condition would create a false negative even though residence may be met no later than the request for payment; and asking only when work started could wrongly hide the independent rule that counted material must have been ordered no earlier than 17 October 2025.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep one product and one truth layer. Add a bounded home-energy discovery handoff inside the existing shared shell, pass only actor/focus/language rather than raw story, ask owner/residence using Boverket's payment-request timing boundary before deeper grant questions, distinguish value year from build year and existing district heating from a planned measure, and in one high-value timing step keep material-order date separate from measure-start date because they control different rule boundaries. Stop safely when the route no longer fits, and end with current Boverket/SFS verification plus independent municipal energy advice rather than an eligibility or amount promise.
